fact: The Rwanda Public Procurement Authority launched an open contracting portal with procurement data back to 2016, downloadable in spreadsheet formats or by API.

The Rwanda Public Procurement Authority publishes Umucyo OCDS procurement data (tenders, awards, contracts, December 2013 to April 2026, updated daily) for download in JSON, Excel and CSV under a CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 licence, per the Open Contracting Partnership registry retrieved 4 October 2026.
Minister Iradukunda says an open data portal provides research datasets in Rwanda.
